payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request session_1b98c8a3ff50 (pid 805) active on 'UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1' waiting on Lock/transactionid, blocked by pid 803 (session_eba5fb376393). That blocker is 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead after having executed the same UPDATE, so it holds an uncommitted row/transaction lock on the inventory row. No evidence of large data, index issues, or vacuum pressure (single-row table, PK index only, trivial query times). Root cause is lock contention from an abandoned open transaction; eligible remediation is rollback of the blocker session. Uncertainty: blocker's transaction state beyond the observed snapshot not verified, but blocking_pids evidence is direct.
